verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches on this indirectly. API tokens can be scoped to specific resources and zones (e.g., access limited to example.com), which could keep non-production automation away from production resources. Workers reach external services only through explicitly declared Bindings, and Zero Trust controls are said to be built into the network. Missing for 10: any documented per-environment configuration (e.g., separate staging and production environments or bindings), runtime network isolation between non-production and production Workers, explicit guidance on blocking non-production access to production services, and hands-on corroboration.
